gates.title: Architecture and runtime foundation
acceptance: seven canonical subsystem owners remain unique
runtime imports resolve
strict 11-stage CEF contract passes
legacy six-stage state is not promoted to full-complete

gates.title: Memory retrieval and lifecycle
acceptance: MemoryOS2 remains sole writable memory owner
restore/replay and forgetting remain idempotent
RU/EN external holdout shows positive paired uplift
temporal/causal/episodic retrieval and abstention are measured

gates.title: Continual learning and skill promotion
acceptance: candidate execution is isolated
verifier and safety scanner are independent
at least five matched seeds on frozen holdout
task success improves without unacceptable forgetting/catastrophes/resource regressions
rollback and restart persistence pass

gates.title: Intrinsic drive and endogenous goals
acceptance: drive estimate has independent confidence
goal owner remains canonical
external requests override epistemic exploration safely
self-initiated useful goals survive long soak and user policy

gates.title: Body, voice, renderer and mobile
acceptance: browser E2E proves rendered pose, reload, replacement and reset
Android E2E proves interruption and audio/viseme clock sync
30-60 minute device soak has no resource leak
all renderer capabilities are truthful

gates.title: Persistence, privacy and release
acceptance: crash/power-loss recovery is tested
forgetting and deletion propagate through all stores
outbound data flow is documented
human license review is complete
release built from exact approved source SHA

gates.title: Selected software gates (does not replace physical device or external evaluation)
acceptance: every subprocess exits zero
all reports are tied to the exact source SHA
device, bilingual holdout and human license gates remain separately tracked
